name: ncrypted
description: One-time, end-to-end encrypted secrets for agents. Share passwords and API keys as self-destructing links, by link, email, or agent handoff. 0.005 USDC per secret via x402.

interface.shortDescription: Share secrets as one-time, self-destructing encrypted links
interface.longDescription: Encrypt a password, API key or sensitive note locally and get a link that opens exactly once. Share it with a person, email it, or hand it to another agent. Creating a secret costs 0.005 USDC on Base via x402; reading is free.
